family_revision_rationale: This family isolates the existing conserved environment-to-processing interface rather than another control-policy or functional-module output. Earlier D3-F/G results tested movement response and ecological alignment, not the direct effect of support on realized raw-resource conversion.
family_revision_interface: Demand-weighted absolute deviation of the phase-shifted local processing multiplier from neutral support, measured on requested conservative raw-resource conversion flow.
hypothesis: Neutralizing phase-shifted spatial processing support changes cumulative realized raw-resource conversion over a fixed acute response window.
interpretation_boundary: This aggregate gate tests the direct conserved interface from spatial support to realized raw-resource conversion while preserving per-unit processing cost, genotype, stores, resource fields and checkpoint state. It does not establish movement response, ecological specialization, stable niches or long-horizon selection.
